content: pytest-asyncio is now at 1.4.0 (verified via PyPI JSON API, published 2026-05-26), a major-version jump from the 0.24.x line assumed in prior project research. Breaking changes in 1.0: removed the deprecated event_loop fixture and asyncio_event_loop mark; async fixtures now set loop_scope explicitly via @pytest_asyncio.fixture(loop_scope=...), and pytest.mark.asyncio(scope=...) becomes pytest.mark.asyncio(loop_scope=...). asyncio_mode config (auto/strict) is retained.
